articles.title: WHO: 1.5 billion children face heatwaves amid new health framework launch - The New Indian Express
articles.full_text:
NEW DELHI: An estimated 1.5 billion children are exposed to heat waves that are becoming more frequent, longer or more severe, said the WHO as it launched the first-ever set of priority indicators to help countries track the health impacts of extreme heat on pregnant women, newborns and children.
The framework aims to strengthen preparedness, improve monitoring and accelerate response. These actions will help protect populations most vulnerable to climate-related health risks.
The initiative responds to intensifying extreme heat around the world and sets a shared basis for countries to identify risks and act.
